problem.summary: 卷积神经网络（CNN）在融合空间和通道信息时，缺乏对通道间依赖关系的显式建模，限制了网络的表示能力。

motivation.summary: 现有研究主要关注增强空间编码，而通道关系对于提升网络性能同样关键。通过自适应地重新校准通道特征响应，可以增强网络的表示能力。

core_idea.summary: 提出“Squeeze-and-Excitation”（SE）模块，通过显式建模通道间的相互依赖关系，自适应地重新校准通道特征响应。

method.summary: SE模块包含两个核心操作：1) Squeeze操作，通过全局平均池化将空间信息压缩为通道描述符；2) Excitation操作，通过一个简单的自门控机制（由两个全连接层和Sigmoid激活函数组成）为每个通道生成权重，用于缩放原始特征。

experiments.summary: 在ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Places365和COCO等多个数据集上，将SE模块集成到多种先进架构（如ResNet、Inception、ResNeXt等）中，验证其有效性。

claims.claim: SE模块能显著提升现有CNN架构的性能，且计算开销极小。
SE模块能有效捕获通道间的依赖关系，实现动态特征重校准。
SE模块在不同网络深度和多种视觉任务上均表现出泛化能力。
SE模块在ILSVRC 2017分类竞赛中取得了第一名的成绩。

limitations.limitation: 论文未深入探讨SE模块的理论基础，其有效性主要基于经验观察。此外，SE模块引入了额外的参数和计算，尽管开销很小。

nodes.title: 输入特征图
nodes.label: Input Feature Maps
nodes.summary: SE模块的输入，通常是一个卷积层的输出特征图。
nodes.description: 输入特征图 U ∈ R^{H×W×C}，其中 H、W、C 分别代表高度、宽度和通道数。

nodes.title: Squeeze操作
nodes.label: Squeeze Operation
nodes.summary: 通过全局平均池化压缩空间信息，生成通道描述符。
nodes.description: 对每个通道的特征图进行全局平均池化，得到一个长度为C的向量 z，其中 z_c = F_sq(u_c) = (1/(H×W)) * Σ_{i=1}^{H} Σ_{j=1}^{W} u_c(i,j)。

nodes.title: Excitation操作
nodes.label: Excitation Operation
nodes.summary: 通过自门控机制为每个通道生成权重。
nodes.description: 使用两个全连接层（FC）和Sigmoid激活函数构建一个瓶颈结构。公式为 s = F_ex(z, W) = σ(g(z, W)) = σ(W_2 * δ(W_1 * z))，其中 δ 是ReLU激活函数，W_1 ∈ R^{(C/r)×C}，W_2 ∈ R^{C×(C/r)}，r是缩减比率。

nodes.title: 缩放操作
nodes.label: Scale Operation
nodes.summary: 使用Excitation生成的权重对原始特征图进行通道加权。
nodes.description: 将Excitation输出的权重s与原始特征图U进行逐通道相乘，得到重校准后的特征图 ˜X。公式为 ˜x_c = F_scale(u_c, s_c) = s_c * u_c。

nodes.title: 输出特征图
nodes.label: Output Feature Maps
nodes.summary: 经过SE模块重校准后的特征图，作为后续层的输入。
nodes.description: 输出特征图 ˜X ∈ R^{H×W×C}，其通道特征响应已被自适应地重新校准。

edges.label: 输入到Squeeze
edges.description: 输入特征图U被送入Squeeze操作进行空间压缩。

edges.label: Squeeze到Excitation
edges.description: Squeeze操作输出的通道描述符z被送入Excitation操作生成通道权重。

edges.label: Excitation到缩放
edges.description: Excitation操作输出的通道权重s被用于缩放原始特征图。

edges.label: 原始特征到缩放
edges.description: 原始输入特征图U与通道权重s进行逐通道相乘。

edges.label: 缩放到输出
edges.description: 缩放操作生成重校准后的特征图 ˜X。

deltas.before: 卷积操作隐式地融合通道信息，无法显式建模通道间的重要性和依赖关系。
deltas.after: SE模块显式地建模通道间依赖关系，并通过学习到的权重对通道特征进行动态重校准。
deltas.why_it_matters: 这使得网络能够自适应地增强重要通道的特征响应，抑制不重要的通道，从而提升网络的表示能力和判别性能。

deltas.before: 网络设计主要关注增强空间编码（如注意力机制），对通道关系的利用不足。
deltas.after: SE模块专注于通道关系，为网络设计提供了一个新的维度。
deltas.why_it_matters: 这补充了现有空间注意力机制，为提升CNN性能提供了新的有效途径。

deltas.before: 增加网络深度或宽度是提升性能的主要方式，但会带来计算和参数量的显著增加。
deltas.after: SE模块以极小的计算和参数开销（例如SE-ResNet-50相比ResNet-50增加约10%的参数和约0.26 GFLOPs）带来显著的性能提升。
deltas.why_it_matters: 这提供了一种高效提升模型性能的方法，尤其适用于计算资源受限的场景。

glossary.Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) Block: 一种用于CNN的架构单元，通过Squeeze（压缩）和Excitation（激励）两个操作，自适应地重新校准通道特征响应。
glossary.Squeeze Operation: SE模块的第一步，通过全局平均池化将每个通道的空间信息压缩为一个标量，生成通道描述符。
glossary.Excitation Operation: SE模块的第二步，通过一个瓶颈结构（两个全连接层和激活函数）学习通道间的依赖关系，并为每个通道生成一个权重。
glossary.Channel-wise Feature Recalibration: 根据学习到的通道权重，对原始特征图的每个通道进行缩放，以增强重要通道、抑制不重要通道。
glossary.Reduction Ratio (r): Excitation操作中瓶颈结构的缩减比率，用于控制中间层的维度，平衡模型复杂度和性能。
glossary.Global Average Pooling: 一种池化操作，计算特征图每个通道所有空间位置的平均值，用于Squeeze操作。
glossary.SE-ResNet: 在ResNet架构中集成SE模块后得到的网络。
glossary.SE-Inception: 在Inception架构中集成SE模块后得到的网络。
glossary.SE-ResNeXt: 在ResNeXt架构中集成SE模块后得到的网络。

metadata.abstract: Convolutional neural networks are built upon the convolution operation, which extracts informative features by fusing spatial and channel-wise information together within local receptive fields. In order to boost the representational power of a network, several recent approaches have shown the benefit of enhancing spatial encoding. In this work, we focus on the channel relationship and propose a novel architectural unit, which we term the "Squeeze-and-Excitation" (SE) block, that adaptively recalibrates channel-wise feature responses by explicitly modelling interdependencies between channels. We demonstrate that by stacking these blocks together, we can construct SENet architectures that generalise extremely well across challenging datasets. Crucially, we find that SE blocks produce significant performance improvements for existing state-of-the-art deep architectures at minimal additional computational cost. SENets formed the foundation of our ILSVRC 2017 classification submission which won first place and significantly reduced the top-5 error to 2.251%, achieving a ~25% relative improvement over the winning entry of 2016. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hujie-frank/SENet.

In order to tackle the issue of exploiting channel depen- dencies, we ﬁrst consider the signal to each channel in the output features. Each of the learned ﬁlters operates with a local receptive ﬁeld and consequently each unit of the transformation output U is unable to exploit contextual information outside of this region. To mitigate this problem, we propose to squeeze global spatial information into a channel descriptor. This is achieved by using global average pooling to generate channel-wise statistics. The SE block can be integrated into standard architectures such as VGGNet [11] by insertion after the non-linearity following each convolution. Moreover, the ﬂexibility of the SE block means that it can be directly applied to transforma- tions beyond standard convolutions. We ﬁrst consider the construction of SE blocks for Incep- tion networks [5]. Here, we simply take the transformation Ftr to be an entire Inception module (see Fig. 2) and by making this change for each such module in the archi- tecture, we obtain an SE-Inception network. complexity. In practice, using an identical ratio throughout a network may not be optimal (due to the distinct roles performed by different layers), so further improvements may be achievable by tuning the ratios to meet the needs of a given base architecture.
6.2 Squeeze Operator
We examine the signiﬁcance of using global average pooling
as opposed to global max pooling as our choice of squeeze
operator (since this worked well, we did not consider more sophisticated alternatives). The results are reported in Ta-

average pooling achieves slightly better performance, jus- tifying its selection as the basis of the squeeze operation. However, we note that the performance of SE blocks is fairly robust to the choice of speciﬁc aggregation operator.

6.4 Different stages

We explore the inﬂuence of SE blocks at different stages by integrating SE blocks into ResNet-50, one stage at a time. Speciﬁcally, we add SE blocks to the intermediate stages: stage 2, stage 3 and stage 4, and report the results in Ta- ble 13. We observe that SE blocks bring performance beneﬁts when introduced at each of these stages of the architecture. Moreover, the gains induced by SE blocks at different stages are complementary, in the sense that they can be combined effectively to further bolster network performance.

7 R OLE OF SE BLOCKS

Although the proposed SE block has been shown to im- prove network performance on multiple visual tasks, we would also like to understand the relative importance of the squeeze operation and how the excitation mechanism operates in practice. A rigorous theoretical analysis of the representations learned by deep neural networks remains challenging, we therefore take an empirical approach to
examining the role played by the SE block with the goal of
attaining at least a primitive understanding of its practical function.
7.1 Effect of Squeeze

8 C ONCLUSION

In this paper we proposed the SE block, an architectural unit designed to improve the representational power of a network by enabling it to perform dynamic channel-wise feature recalibration. A wide range of experiments show the effectiveness of SENets, which achieve state-of-the-art performance across multiple datasets and tasks. In addition, SE blocks shed some light on the inability of previous architectures to adequately model channel-wise feature de- pendencies. We hope this insight may prove useful for other
tasks requiring strong discriminative features. Finally, the

feature importance values produced by SE blocks may be of use for other tasks such as network pruning for model compression.
